recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中細胞密集，可見數顆巨核細胞體積偏小、核分葉少或呈分離的圓形核，旁邊有成群的紅血球系前驅細胞；多系（巨核細胞、紅血球系）形態異常是 MDS 多系發育不良的線索。
features: Megakaryocytes of variable size, some small with hypolobated or separated round nuclear lobes
Megakaryocytes loosely grouped rather than evenly dispersed
Clusters of erythroid precursors with round dark nuclei
Maturing granulocytes present; no sheets of blasts
describe_en: H&E section of the bone marrow core biopsy shows a hypercellular marrow with trilineage hematopoiesis. Megakaryocytes vary in size and include small forms with hypolobated or widely separated round nuclear lobes, some loosely grouped. Erythroid precursors form clusters, and granulocytic maturation is present without sheets of blasts. The findings are compatible with multilineage dysplasia, in keeping with MDS with ring sideroblasts and multilineage dysplasia; aspirate morphology and iron stain provide confirmation.

ddx.vs: MPN megakaryocytes are typically large with hyperlobated or cloud-like nuclei in tight clusters, unlike the small hypolobated forms here.
Del(5q) megakaryocytes are predominantly monolobated with normal/large size and require karyotype confirmation.
Reactive states lack consistent multilineage dysplasia, ring sideroblasts, and clonal genetic abnormalities.
